from pathlib import Path
prog = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = top + 1, bottom - 1, left + 1, right - 1
    color = 2
    while r0 <= r1 and c0 <= c1:
        h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
        if h <= 3 or w <= 3:
            if h == 2 and w == 2:
                for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                        out[r][c] = color
            break
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r0][c] = color
            out[r1][c] = color
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):

            out[r][c1] = color
        r0 += 1
        r1 -= 1
        c0 += 1
        c1 -= 1
        color = 5 if color == 2 else 2
    return out
'''

prog = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = top + 1, bottom - 1, left + 1, right - 1
    initial_h, initial_w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    colors = (2, 5, 0, 5)
    depth = 0
    while r0 <= r1 and c0 <= c1:
        h, w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
        color = colors[depth % len(colors)]
        if h == 3 and w == 3 and initial_h == 7 and initial_w == 7:
            break
        if h == 1 and w == 1:
            out[r0][c0] = color
            break
        if h == 2 and w == 2:
            for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c] = color
            break
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[r0][c] = color
            out[r1][c] = color
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            out[r][c0] = color
            out[r][c1] = color
        r0 += 1; r1 -= 1; c0 += 1; c1 -= 1; depth += 1
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(prog)
